args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18). I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Post-rollback status: v2.3.0 in all three regions, healthy=true, error rate 0.002. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production and should not be redeployed until it is fixed. Note: v2.3.1-rc was healthy in staging only and was not used as the rollback target. Follow-up: investigate the v2.3.1 failure and confirm checkout traffic is normal.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Rollback target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging, so I didn't use it.
- **Current state:** all three regions are on v2.3.0, healthy, with an error rate of 0.002. Before the rollback it was 0.18 on v2.3.1.
- **Approval:** no change-manager approval was needed, because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback, and the post-rollback metrics. It notes that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until it is fixed.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1-rc was healthy only in staging, so it doesn't count. Rolling back to v2.3.0.
